body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage and push it 2 units.

surges.html: Deal +1 Damage if it ends beside a solid obstacle.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Golem
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Golem Full Manifestation (FM-1G). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
